stem.text: Wave-power generators take advantage of the energy that is transferred by the motion of waves across the surface of the oceans. The energy of a wave depends on its amplitude.
What is the correct definition of amplitude?

A.text: the average amount of energy possessed by a wave

B.text: the difference in displacement between a peak and a trough

C.text: the maximum displacement of a point on the wave from equilibrium

D.text: the number of oscillations of a wave that occur per second
